nodes.text:
Plate, mail, helm, shield. And a bucket of rivets, if you're the sort who asks.

I'll mend what you're wearing while you stand in it, if you don't mind the noise.

choices.label: Does any of it actually help?

nodes.text:
Some. Not the way you'd like.

A good plate turns a bad blow into a worse bruise. It won't turn a bad blow into nothing — nothing that lands on you lands for nothing, and anyone who tells you different is selling worse iron than mine.
